affected_component: workspace_semantic verdict_details for mechanism codes + drafting prompt reproducibility rule
invariant: Every mechanism reason code the semantic screen itself produces (INPUT/ARTIFACT/UPSTREAM_RESULT binding control failures, UPSTREAM_CALL_NOT_OBSERVED, COMMITMENT_COVERAGE_MISMATCH with the missing and extra commitment ids) carries a public reason_detail stating what was observed and which rule it violates, so a judge repair is evidence-based for Harness-side rejections exactly as it already is for the verifier's own codes. The drafting prompt additionally teaches byte-reproducibility up front (no clock, no random ids, pinned container timestamps, sorted collections).
